background.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: high resolution painted background for a side-scrolling village exploration website called Windbell Valley. Create an exquisitely detailed extremely wide 3:1 panorama, ideally 3840x1280. Warm hand-painted Japanese animated film background sensibility, gouache and watercolor on textured paper, delicate graphite outlines, late summer golden light, enchanting but believable everyday rural life. Side-on / slightly elevated SIDE-SCROLLING view, NOT an isometric map. Continuous long level pale ochre footpath running horizontally across entire foreground at about 82% of image height, generous open walking surface from 77% to 91%; grassy flowers along bottom edge. No people or animals anywhere; actors will be composited later. In back-to-front layers: distant soft teal mountain ridges and creamy blue sky, rolling forest, quaint old wooden cottages with tiled terracotta roofs and ivy. Compose FIVE connected distinct districts seamlessly left-to-right: left edge a sleepy small timber railway halt beside orchard trees and flower carts; at 25% a cozy bakery with orange awning and outdoor bench; middle a cluster of windbell tea house, village square with huge leafy tree and warm paper lanterns, laundry drying and abundant hydrangeas; at 70% a sparkling narrow stream descending from hillside and crossing beneath a broad old stone footbridge ON the foreground path, with old timber watermill and round wooden waterwheel beside stream; right a cottage garden with sunflower field and grassy hillside leading into deep forest. A few tiny hanging glass windbells under eaves. Distinct roofs, lush green leaves, earthy coral, honey amber, pale celadon, warm cream. Painterly environmental storytelling, beautiful rich irregular brush texture, no hard digital gradients, no pixel art, no 3D. All architectural elements at consistent side-view scale, village roofs located in middle band, clear ground in bottom quarter for movement. Entire panorama MUST be filled edge to edge, no frame, no margin, no captions, no letters, no text, no logo, no watermark. Draw the environment only, absolutely no characters.

characters.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: real transparent PNG character animation atlas for a warm hand-painted side scrolling village game. Generate a precisely organized sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, 16 equal-sized cells, canvas 1536x1024, each cell exactly 384x256. All characters are small full-body side view hand-painted gouache watercolor drawings with delicate pencil outlines, Japanese cozy animated film atmosphere. Every figure uses same feet ground line, centered in its cell with generous clear transparent margin, fully separated, no overlap, no grid lines, no labels, no shadows, no floor, no scenery. Rows each are four-frame RIGHT-FACING WALK CYCLE of ONE identical character, same identity and clothing across all four frames: columns sequential left leg forward, passing legs, right leg forward, passing legs. Feet near 88% of cell height. Row 1: young female traveler with short dark brown bob haircut, soft sage green pinafore dress over cream short sleeve blouse, brown ankle boots, little burnt orange backpack, friendly and curious. Row 2: elderly female tea maker with gray hair in bun, warm mustard cardigan, cream apron over dark blue skirt, brown slippers, carrying small tea basket. Row 3: young male postman with indigo cap, dusty blue shirt, brown trousers and messenger satchel, walking cheerfully. Row 4: a round adorable orange tabby cat, full body side-on with tail curled up, walking on four paws. Consistent character identity throughout each row, credible alternating leg positions, upper body stays stable. Cute but not chibi, stylized storybook proportion. True transparent background, no white or colored background, no text, no watermark. IMPORTANT exactly 4x4 orderly separated sprites, all facing RIGHT; no front views.
